scope: chips only; floorplan and predicted-control are out of scope
objective: Close the publication-blocking chips gaps in dependency order: freeze the protocol, certify the public anchor, repair metric-owned model atoms, resolve long-budget and route-transfer failures, then run seed, fresh-cohort, ablation and external-PPA certification.
current_claim: Under the matched 1k-subset/1600-step dev32 protocol, the typed per-block trajectory candidate improves mean legalized cost and V_rel over its own control. This is not a public-anchor, seed-stable, fresh-cohort, routed-PPA or SOTA claim.

claim_levels.mechanism_evidence: A repaired atom improves its owned real metric against a matched control without a guardrail regression.
claim_levels.public_anchor_evidence: The frozen endpoint is non-worse on both primary metrics and better on at least one, with case-clustered paired intervals excluding zero on the claimed metric.
claim_levels.coverage_evidence: The same frozen endpoint reaches the predeclared JSR/CSJ thresholds on a case-disjoint fresh cohort.
claim_levels.external_ppa_evidence: Routed WL, congestion and DRC are non-regressive on an outcome-unopened source-disjoint cohort with valid candidate/control pairs.
claim_levels.SOTA_claim: Requires public-anchor evidence, seed stability, fresh coverage, routed-PPA transfer and budget certification.

best_local_dev32.protocol: 1k frozen training subset, 1600 training steps, 32 case-disjoint dev cases, NFE4/refiner1600, seed21
best_local_dev32.primary_intervals: cost and V_rel still cross zero

public_anchor_status.note: Component gaps are structural diagnostics and are not attributed to a single decoder, data or sampling choice.

fresh500.decision: Rejected as confirmation; primary intervals cross zero and the candidate-pool ceiling is below the CSJ gate.

matched_1600.decision: Mean boundary only; primary and component intervals cross zero and several structural components regress.

external_ppa.decision: Negative external transfer; not a fresh holdout.

proxy_real.decision: Raw geometry and legalizer telemetry remain diagnostic-only until they pass the shared proxy-real contract.

gap_register.current: The best dev32 comparison and the public Trinity comparison use different endpoints and evidence packages.
gap_register.target: One manifest, endpoint, legalizer, sampler, seed policy and report schema for every public-anchor comparison.

gap_register.current: The current 1.1196/0.03194 endpoint has not been paired with Trinity d192.
gap_register.target: At one declared budget, both primary metrics are non-worse and at least one is better with a favorable paired interval.

gap_register.current: Dev32 mean cost and V_rel improve, but both intervals cross zero.
gap_register.target: Reproduce the primary direction on independent seeds and cases without post-hoc endpoint selection.

gap_register.current: Public component gaps remain: area +24.83%, rho +10.92%, grouping +33.19%; fresh500 grouping regresses +20.15%.
gap_register.target: Generate joint area/rho/grouping-safe candidates and raise the legalized candidate-pool oracle.

gap_register.current: B2b remains +41.50% versus the reproducible anchor; high-degree and high-complexity tails are the main residual failure.
gap_register.target: Reduce legalized b2b and cost p90/p95 without trading away grouping or legality.

gap_register.current: P2b improves strongly, but valid routed pairs still worsen routed WL by +1.408% on average.
gap_register.target: Require non-negative route-family sign agreement before promoting p2b and preserve the gain on external routed metrics.

gap_register.current: At matched 1600 steps the current candidate has only a mean boundary against Trinity and regresses b2b, area and grouping.
gap_register.target: Remove the long-budget ceiling with refiner, optimizer, EMA, schedule and endpoint-state repairs.

gap_register.current: Only seed21 establishes the latest matched-control mean; prior seed directions are heterogeneous.
gap_register.target: At least 4/5 seeds preserve primary direction with the endpoint frozen before results are inspected.

gap_register.current: Fresh500 candidate-pool oracle is 31.4%, below the 35% CSJ requirement.
gap_register.target: JSR >= 65% and CSJ >= 35% on a distinct fresh500 cohort after the pool oracle passes.

gap_register.current: Earlier complexity adapters were trained on 21-60 blocks and tested on 81-120, so their rejection is confounded.
gap_register.target: Use the existing 21-120 range cache and improve the 81-120 stratum at equal sample exposure.

gap_register.current: The only public primary win required 10 trajectories, NFE14, refiner16000 and 15 legalizer calls; equal-quality efficiency is absent.
gap_register.target: At least one predeclared candidate budget reaches the declared baseline quality with no hidden extra search.

gap_register.current: Only 8 valid completed external designs exist; 13 source-disjoint designs are missing for a 15-design confirmation.
gap_register.target: 15-20 outcome-unopened source-disjoint pairs with valid TCL hashes, common routes, non-regressive WL/congestion and zero DRC regression.

gap_register.current: Typed graph, per-block residuals, boundary coupler, stage LR, atom isolation and reliability gates are bundled; attribution is incomplete.
gap_register.target: Each retained mechanism beats an equal-parameter or equal-budget structural control on its owned metric.

atom_evaluation_contract.hard_rule: A proxy that fails this contract cannot select a candidate, checkpoint, arm or claim.

execution_ladder.cpu_first: Protocol, manifests, atom ownership, proxy-real audit, pair-integrity and tests.
execution_ladder.small_screen: 1k frozen training subset and 32 or 92 case-disjoint dev cases; never start with full data.
execution_ladder.fresh_debug: Fresh150 is diagnostic and must not be reused as confirmation.
execution_ladder.fresh_confirmation: A distinct fresh500 cohort is evaluated once after the endpoint and thresholds are frozen.
execution_ladder.gpu: Use cuda:0 only after the CPU contract passes; one atom-repair arm at a time per parallel slot.
execution_ladder.full_data: Forbidden until the small-screen and fresh-debug gates pass.
execution_ladder.evidence: Only legalized, case-clustered paired reports can promote a task.

reuse_catalog.policy: Search and reuse these owners before adding a module; a new module must name the missing responsibility and replace or wrap an existing path.

actions: Create one chip case manifest whose IDs are consumed by both FloorFlow and Trinity.
Freeze candidate/control checkpoints, Trinity d192 anchor, legalizer, NFE/refiner budget, inference seeds and report schema.
Synchronize the A01-A42 registry with current code ownership and fail closed on unowned or duplicated trainable atoms.
Add SHA-256 and command provenance to every comparison and reject cross-manifest joins.
tasks.gate: Contract test, full chip test suite, Ruff and the below-600-line audit pass before any GPU job.

actions: Evaluate the frozen best candidate, matched control and Trinity d192 on identical cases and budget.
Run a 32-case diagnostic for protocol validity, then the predeclared confirmation cohort.
Decompose the remaining gap into cost, area, b2b, grouping, boundary, p2b and rho without causal attribution to the decoder.
Keep the legacy unseeded Trinity result in the appendix only.
tasks.promotion_gate: Both primary metrics non-worse, at least one better, and its case-clustered 95% interval excludes zero.
tasks.reject_if: Case IDs, legalizer, budget, seed policy or endpoint differ between arms.

model_actions: Audit factorized shape, hierarchy group state, endpoint modes and atom aggregation before adding parameters.
Train independent area, rho and grouping evidence heads on cached target-free candidate features.
Generate new legalizer-compatible candidates that jointly change shape/grouping instead of reranking the rejected pool.
Use the existing typed atom aggregator only after out-of-fold atom evidence clears the proxy contract.
tasks.promotion_gate: At least one owned real metric improves, primary metrics do not regress, pool oracle rises, and no legality/headroom regression occurs.
tasks.reject_if: Only selector weights or raw proxies improve, or grouping is traded away for area/rho.

model_actions: Audit symmetric b2b messages, hyperedge incidence, degree expert and dynamic state relay for edge-direction and reachability defects.
Repair one graph mechanism at a time with an equal-parameter dense/static control.
Train a tail-aware b2b candidate head with legality veto outside the averaged utility.
Measure high-degree and 81-120 block strata separately.
tasks.promotion_gate: Legalized b2b or cost tail improves with no primary, grouping, boundary or legality regression.
tasks.reject_if: Raw b2b improves while legalized b2b/cost does not; reverse graph messages alone are not evidence.

model_actions: Audit port refinement order, dual semantic ports, occupancy field and legalizer residual interaction.
Add routing-aware macro spacing or L-path obstruction only through the existing target-free route field and zero-gated head.
Require route-family proxy-real agreement before enabling a new routing objective.
Test a bounded post-generation spacing repair separately from the hard projector.
tasks.promotion_gate: P2b plus non-negative routed-WL/congestion transfer on a five-design mini screen before a larger route cohort.
tasks.reject_if: P2b improves while routed WL or congestion worsens; no post-refiner projector promotion.

model_actions: Audit refiner capacity, learning-rate decay, EMA state, stage-local LR restart and fusion saturation at 400/800/1600 steps.
Reuse the Trinity refiner interface before adding a new refiner.
Repair the first saturated or oscillating component identified by optimizer/update-norm diagnostics.
Test endpoint compatibility and legalizer response as bounded residuals with explicit trust regions.
tasks.promotion_gate: At equal 1600-step inference, primary metrics beat or match Trinity with a favorable primary interval and no component guardrail reversal.
tasks.reject_if: Improvement exists only at a different budget or requires choosing the endpoint after inspection.

model_actions: Train complexity conditioner, degree expert and complexity-slot adapter as separate 21-120 arms on a frozen small subset.
Keep sample exposure, seeds, schedule and NFE equal to the control.
Promote the 81-120 gate only when lower strata remain within the predeclared regression tolerance.
tasks.promotion_gate: 81-120 block cost and V_rel improve without lower-complexity or grouping regression.
tasks.reject_if: The module only raises activation or consumes extra compute without tail gain.

actions: Freeze one endpoint and run seeds 19-23 with matched controls.
Run a case-disjoint fresh150 diagnostic and require the candidate-pool oracle to exceed the coverage threshold before fresh500.
Evaluate a distinct, previously unopened fresh500 once.
Report JSR, CSJ, primary metrics and p50/p75/p90/p95 by block count, b2b degree and pin density.
tasks.reject_if: Seeds or endpoints are chosen after results, or fresh150 is reused as fresh500.

actions: Evaluate NFE 1/2/4/8 and refiner steps 50/100/400/800/1600 with one frozen endpoint.
Include trajectories, legalizer calls and wall time in the same budget record.
Mark the baseline equal-quality lines before inspecting candidate outcomes.
Retain the 50-step quality-loss point instead of hiding it.
tasks.promotion_gate: At least one predeclared candidate point reaches baseline reference quality on both primary metrics.
tasks.reject_if: The equal-quality budget is selected post hoc or extra search is omitted.

actions: Repair collapsed ChiPBench legalized pairs and require distinct TCL hashes before routing.
Source 13 additional outcome-unopened source-disjoint macro-capable designs.
Pin ORFS image, route seed, route recipe and config hashes.
Route one diagnostic pair, then 15-20 designs with the frozen recipe.
Report routed WL, overflow/congestion, DRC, WNS/TNS, power and area.
tasks.promotion_gate: Valid source-disjoint cohort, non-regressive routed WL and congestion, zero DRC regression, and complete timing/power reporting.
tasks.reject_if: Candidate/control TCL collapse, route mismatch, missing endpoints or seed-only pseudo-replication.

actions: Run equal-parameter dense-cross-attention and global-slot controls.
Remove netlist/cluster conditioning and per-block graph-token residuals separately.
Toggle reliability-gated atom aggregation, atom isolation and stage-local LR separately.
Toggle conservative boundary acceptance and the hard projector separately.
Toggle route-obstruction conditioning only after the proxy-real gate passes.
tasks.promotion_gate: At least one graph/per-block mechanism has a repeatable advantage on its owned legalized metric without a legality regression.
tasks.reject_if: The effect disappears under an equal-parameter control or is explained by extra search budget.

actions: Assemble only reports that passed their gates; keep failed arms in the negative appendix.
Map each claim sentence to one frozen report, manifest hash, budget and allowed boundary.
Include the reproducible Trinity three-seed anchor as the main comparator and the legacy anchor only as an appendix.
State explicitly that component gaps are structural diagnostics, not decoder/attribution estimates.
tasks.completion_rule: No prose claim exists without a passed machine-readable gate.

forbidden_claims_until_passed: routed-PPA, congestion, power or timing superiority
monotonic improvement across all tail quantiles
